name: mai-wadi
description: MAI WADI — customer website, admin dashboard and API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,admin -c blue,cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev:memory" "npm:dev:frontend" "npm:dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
